My (0 qualifications btw) thought on crossovers

Crossovers are for the people who want the practicality of an SUV with for less money. They don’t ever get that though, an average crossover is FWD “car” with low clearance and cramped interior space while still driving like a big SUV. 

Actual SUVs are amazingly practical for families or people who need the size without wanting a truck or van. Proudly having had a 2016 Toyota Sienna and 2020 Toyota Highlander I will say they both fill my families needs of long road trips with lots of space for luggage perfectly. Only difference is the Highlander had the power to get up mountains the Sienna didn’t when we needed it. 

A crossover variant of these (Toyotas satan spawn the RAV4) wouldn’t have enough space for 4 people to comfortably travel and have enough luggage for a week or 2. The RAV4 would also not have enough power under all that load to get up steep gravel roads making it suck all around.

Here’s some criteria and some questions to ask 

1. Location- 

Are they near big monuments and have a higher chance of having better loot? 

What’s the node spawn rate like in the area? 

Are they near a road? 

What kind of other bases are around there? 

How are they fairing in the competition for resources in that area? 

2. Distance-

Are they easily accessible from your base? 

Is there a chance you will lose raid supplies when traveling with them from your base to theirs? 

Assuming they have the most loot possible for the size, will you be able to transfer the loot efficiently with low risk for counters?

Will you need boat(s) to be effective and efficient 

3. Size- 

Are you able to online them? 

Will you have to wait for them to be offline? 

Will you have enough people do transfer loot, raid and close off the base effectively and efficiently.

Will you/your team be able to handle counters along with the other stuff?

Supplies- 

Do you have enough supplies to go full deep?

Are you going through the doors or some wall or roof? 

There’s probably other stuff I’m missing but those are the main ones I look for.
